_comment: Shared, committed vault settings. Every contributor sees the same copy.
Personal settings live in .wiki/memory_local.md, which is git-ignored.
last_reorganized_at   ISO date of the last structure review. The session-startup
check flags a reorg as overdue 30 days after this, OR as soon
as any folder holds more than 25 notes - whichever comes first.
recent_touch_hours    Window for the 'someone else just edited this' heads-up before
writing to a note. Read by contributors.py query --since-hours.
reorg_stale_days      Days before last_reorganized_at counts as overdue.
reorg_folder_notes    Notes in one folder before a reorg is flagged regardless of date.
intake_wave           Units filed per wave in intake mode. A ceiling, not a target.
dashboard_port        Port for the wiki UI (`serve.py`), bound to 127.0.0.1 only.
null means derive one from this vault's own path, so two
vaults never open on the same port. Set a number to pin it.
knowledge_profile     The doctrine this vault decomposes knowledge by, or null. Set at
init, changed only by reshape - it decides which overlay the local
skill's instructions carry.
hidden_folders        Folders the UI must not LIST, matched on whole path segments.
/api/note still serves them - hiding is a listing decision, not an
access one. [] means nothing is hidden, which is the default.
relation_types        EXTRA relation types this vault allows in `## Related` lines, on top
of the built-in closed vocabulary (relates-to, part-of, requires,
regulates, implements, supersedes, superseded-by, contradicts,
example-of, defined-in). Add one only when a real question needs it:
an open vocabulary is unqueryable, which defeats typing relations.
